displayName.description:
A user-friendly name of the monitored instance. It is binded to [Compute Instance](/Content/Compute/Concepts/computeoverview.htm).
DisplayName is fetched from [Core Service API](/api/#/en/iaas/20160918/Instance/).

lifecycleDetails.description: A message describing the current state in more detail. For example, can be used to provide actionable information for a resource in Failed state.

lifecycleState.description: The current state of the monitored instance.

managementAgentId.description:
Management Agent Identifier [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).
Used to invoke manage operations on Management Agent Cloud Service.

monitoringState.description: Monitoring status. Can be either enabled or disabled.

timeCreated.description: The time the MonitoredInstance was created. An RFC3339 formatted datetime string

timeUpdated.description: The time the MonitoredInstance was updated. An RFC3339 formatted datetime string
